newsitem.title: USA: Peapod says loss was due to expansion.
newsitem.headline: Peapod says loss was due to expansion.

text.p: Peapod Inc said its second quarter loss was due to higher costs for grocery operation expenses due to geographic expansion during the quarter and the past year.

"In the most recent quarter we added 17 fulfillment centers covering an additional 1.4 million households, and in the past year we added 44 fulfillment centers covering 4.1 million households," Andrew Parkinson, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
Earlier Peapod earlier said it lost $3.0 million, or $0.22 a share, in the second quarter compared to a loss of $2.1 million, or $0.16 a share, in the same period last year.

"During the remainder of 1997 ... we intend to pursue continued, aggressive growth in membership, orders and service areas. Our recently completed initial public offering, in which we raised net proceeds of approximately $58 million, provides us with the capital to support this growth. As membership and orders expand, we look forward to providing interactive marketing services of increasing value to consumer package goods companies and to offering additional online stores and services to our membership," Parkinson said.
